keywords.name: variables
keywords.description: Global variable declaration section. Variables declared here are visible in all event procedures and functions of the node.

keywords.name: this
keywords.description: Inside an event procedure: the object that triggered the event (message, frame, signal, system variable, key…).

keywords.name: testcase
keywords.description: Defines a test case in a test module / test unit. Can be called from `MainTest()` or listed in the XML test module.

keywords.name: testfunction
keywords.description: Defines a test function that can be called from an XML test module.

keywords.name: export
keywords.description: Makes a `testcase`/`testfunction` or function visible to test units / other nodes.

keywords.name: switch
keywords.description: Multi-way branch on an integer value.

keywords.name: for
keywords.description: Loop statement. CAPL also supports range iteration over arrays and associative arrays: `for (long key : map) { ... }`.

keywords.name: while
keywords.description: Loop while the condition is true.

keywords.name: break
keywords.description: Leaves the innermost loop or switch.

keywords.name: continue
keywords.description: Jumps to the next loop iteration.

keywords.name: return
keywords.description: Returns from a function (optionally with a value).

keywords.name: struct
keywords.description: Declares a structure type (supported since CANoe 7.x; nested structs and struct arrays allowed).

keywords.name: _align
keywords.description: Controls struct member alignment, e.g. `_align(1) struct Packed { ... };`.

keywords.name: static
keywords.description: Local variable keeps its value between calls.

keywords.name: sizeof
keywords.description: Size of a variable or type in bytes.

keywords.name: int
keywords.description: 16-bit signed integer (32-bit since CANoe 11 when `int` is configured as 32 bit).

keywords.name: float
keywords.description: Floating point (in CAPL `float` is a 64-bit IEEE double).

keywords.name: message
keywords.description: CAN message object. `message 0x100 m;`, `message EngineData m;` or `message * m;`.

keywords.name: timer
keywords.description: Timer with second resolution. Fires `on timer <name>`.

keywords.name: msTimer
keywords.description: Timer with millisecond resolution. Fires `on timer <name>`.

keywords.name: sysvar
keywords.description: Reference to a system variable (`sysvar * sv;`).

keywords.name: sysvarInt
keywords.description: Reference to an integer system variable.

keywords.name: sysvarFloat
keywords.description: Reference to a float system variable.

keywords.name: sysvarString
keywords.description: Reference to a string system variable.

keywords.name: diagRequest
keywords.description: Diagnostic request object from the CDD/ODX description, e.g. `diagRequest Door.SerialNumber_Read req;`.

keywords.name: start
keywords.description: `on start` — executed when the measurement starts (after `on preStart`).

keywords.name: preStart
keywords.description: `on preStart` — executed before the measurement starts; bus access is not yet possible.

keywords.name: preStop
keywords.description: `on preStop` — executed when stopping the measurement is requested. Use `deferStop()` to delay.

keywords.name: stopMeasurement
keywords.description: `on stopMeasurement` — executed at the end of the measurement.

keywords.name: key
keywords.description: `on key 'a'`, `on key F1`, `on key ctrlF5`, `on key *` — keyboard event.

keywords.name: message
keywords.description: `on message <id|name|*>` — CAN (FD) message received/sent. Use `CAN1.Msg` to filter by channel.

keywords.name: signal_update
keywords.description: `on signal_update <name>` — signal was received (even with the same value).

keywords.name: sysvar_update
keywords.description: `on sysvar_update <Ns::Var>` — system variable was written (even with the same value).

keywords.name: envVar
keywords.description: `on envVar <name>` — environment variable changed (legacy; prefer system variables).

keywords.name: errorActive
keywords.description: `on errorActive` — CAN controller entered error-active state.

keywords.name: errorPassive
keywords.description: `on errorPassive` — CAN controller entered error-passive state.

keywords.name: warningLimit
keywords.description: `on warningLimit` — CAN controller reached the warning limit.

keywords.name: diagRequest

functions.name: write
functions.description: Writes formatted text to the *Write* window (printf-style).

functions.name: writeEx
functions.description: Writes formatted text to a Write-window page or log without a newline.

parameters.name: sink
parameters.description: -3 trace, -2 log, -1 reserved, 0 System, 1 CAPL, 4 Test

functions.name: writeLineEx
functions.description: Like `writeEx` but terminates the line.

functions.name: writeClear
functions.description: Clears a page of the Write window.

functions.name: writeCreate
functions.description: Creates a new page in the Write window and returns its sink ID.

functions.name: writeDbgLevel
functions.description: Writes only if `priority` ≤ the level set by `setWriteDbgLevel`.

functions.name: setWriteDbgLevel
functions.description: Sets the threshold for `writeDbgLevel`.

functions.name: snprintf
functions.description: Formats into a buffer. Returns number of characters written.

functions.name: output
functions.description: Transmits a message/frame/PDU object on the bus.

functions.name: canOnline
functions.description: Restores the node's connection to the CAN bus.

functions.name: canOffline
functions.description: Disconnects the node from the CAN bus.

functions.name: resetCan
functions.description: Resets the CAN controller.

functions.name: getBusContext
functions.description: Returns the bus context of the current or named bus.

functions.name: setBusContext
functions.description: Sets the bus context for subsequent bus functions; returns the previous one.

functions.name: getBusNameContext
functions.description: Returns the bus context for the given bus name.

functions.name: mkExtId
functions.description: Returns an extended (29-bit) CAN identifier.

functions.name: isExtId
functions.description: Checks whether an identifier is extended.

functions.name: valOfId
functions.description: Returns the plain identifier value without the extended flag.

functions.name: linSendHeader
functions.description: Sends a LIN header (master only).

functions.name: linChangeSchedtable
functions.description: Switches the LIN master to another schedule table.

functions.name: linStartScheduler
functions.description: Starts the LIN master scheduler.

functions.name: linStopScheduler
functions.description: Stops the LIN master scheduler.

functions.name: frSetSendFrame
functions.description: Configures a FlexRay frame for transmission.

functions.name: setTimer
functions.description: Starts a timer. Unit is seconds for `timer`, milliseconds for `msTimer`.

functions.name: setTimerCyclic
functions.description: Starts a cyclic timer.

functions.name: cancelTimer
functions.description: Stops a running timer.

functions.name: isTimerActive
functions.description: Returns 1 if the timer is running.

functions.name: timeToElapse
functions.description: Remaining time until the timer fires.

functions.name: timeNow
functions.description: Measurement time in units of 10 µs.

functions.name: timeNowNS
functions.description: Measurement time in nanoseconds.

functions.name: timeNowFloat
functions.description: Measurement time in units of 10 µs as float.

functions.name: timeNowInt64
functions.description: Measurement time in nanoseconds as int64.

functions.name: timeDiff
functions.description: Time difference between two messages or a message and now, in ms.

functions.name: getLocalTime
functions.description: Fills a `long[9]` array with the local date/time (sec, min, hour, mday, mon, year-1900, wday, yday, isdst).

functions.name: getLocalTimeString
functions.description: Writes the local time as text into a buffer (≥ 26 chars).

functions.name: getValue
functions.description: Reads an environment variable. Prefer `$EnvVar` / `@sysvar::` syntax in new code.

functions.name: putValue
functions.description: Writes an environment variable. Prefer `@sysvar::` syntax in new code.

functions.name: sysGetVariableInt
functions.description: Reads an integer system variable by namespace/name.

functions.name: sysSetVariableInt
functions.description: Writes an integer system variable. Returns 0 on success.

functions.name: sysGetVariableFloat
functions.description: Reads a float system variable.

functions.name: sysSetVariableFloat
functions.description: Writes a float system variable.

functions.name: sysGetVariableString
functions.description: Reads a string system variable into a buffer.

functions.name: sysSetVariableString
functions.description: Writes a string system variable.

functions.name: sysDefineNamespace
functions.description: Creates a system-variable namespace at runtime.

functions.name: sysDefineVariableInt
functions.description: Creates an integer system variable at runtime.

functions.name: getSignal
functions.description: Returns the current physical value of a signal (prefer `$Signal`).

functions.name: setSignal
functions.description: Sets a signal's physical value via the Interaction Layer (prefer `$Signal = v`).

functions.name: getRawSignal
functions.description: Returns the raw value of a signal (prefer `$Signal.raw`).

functions.name: setRawSignal
functions.description: Sets the raw value of a signal.

functions.name: getSignalTime
functions.description: Time of the last signal update.

functions.name: strlen
functions.description: Length of a zero-terminated string.

functions.name: strncpy
functions.description: Copies at most `len-1` characters and terminates the destination.

functions.name: strncpy_off
functions.description: Copies into dest starting at an offset.

functions.name: strncat
functions.description: Appends src to dest; `len` is the size of dest.

functions.name: strncmp
functions.description: Compares at most `len` characters.

functions.name: strstr
functions.description: Position of `s2` in `s1`, or -1.

functions.name: strstr_regex
functions.description: Position of the first regex match, or -1.

functions.name: str_match_regex
functions.description: 1 if the whole string matches the regular expression.

functions.name: str_replace
functions.description: Replaces occurrences of `search` with `replacement`.

functions.name: substr_cpy
functions.description: Copies a substring.

functions.name: toUpper
functions.description: Converts a character (or string, overload) to upper case.

functions.name: toLower
functions.description: Converts a character (or string, overload) to lower case.

functions.name: atol
functions.description: Converts a string (decimal or 0x hex) to long.

functions.name: atodbl
functions.description: Converts a string to double.

functions.name: ltoa
functions.description: Converts a number to a string in the given base.

functions.name: elcount
functions.description: Number of elements of an array (or keys of an associative array).

functions.name: abs
functions.description: Absolute value.

functions.name: sqrt
functions.description: Square root.

functions.name: exp
functions.description: e^x.

functions.name: _pow
functions.description: x raised to the power y.

functions.name: _round
functions.description: Rounds to the nearest integer.

functions.name: _floor
functions.description: Largest integer ≤ x.

functions.name: _ceil
functions.description: Smallest integer ≥ x.

functions.name: _max
functions.description: Maximum of two values.

functions.name: _min
functions.description: Minimum of two values.

functions.name: sin
functions.description: Sine (radians).

functions.name: cos
functions.description: Cosine (radians).

functions.name: random
functions.description: Pseudo-random number in [0, x).

functions.name: swapWord
functions.description: Swaps the bytes of a 16-bit value.

functions.name: swapDWord
functions.description: Swaps the bytes of a 32-bit value.

functions.name: memcpy
functions.description: Copies bytes between arrays/structs.

functions.name: memcmp
functions.description: Compares bytes of two arrays/structs.

functions.name: memset
functions.description: Fills an array with a byte value.

functions.name: stop
functions.description: Stops the measurement.

functions.name: deferStop
functions.description: Delays the end of the measurement (inside `on preStop`) by up to `maxDeferTime` ms.

functions.name: completeStop
functions.description: Signals that `on preStop` work is complete.

functions.name: halt
functions.description: Halts the simulation (breakpoint-like) in simulated mode.

functions.name: runError
functions.description: Raises a CAPL runtime error and stops the measurement.

functions.name: beep
functions.description: Plays a tone.

functions.name: openFileRead
functions.description: Opens a file for reading; returns handle (0 on error).

functions.name: openFileWrite
functions.description: Opens a file for writing; returns handle (0 on error).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: 0 ASCII, 1 binary, 2 append ASCII, 3 append binary

functions.name: fileGetString
functions.description: Reads a line from a file.

functions.name: filePutString
functions.description: Writes a string to a file.

functions.name: fileClose
functions.description: Closes a file handle.

functions.name: getAbsFilePath
functions.description: Resolves a path relative to the configuration.

functions.name: testModuleTitle
functions.description: Sets the test module title in the report.

functions.name: testModuleDescription
functions.description: Sets the test module description in the report.

functions.name: testGroupBegin
functions.description: Begins a test group in the report.

functions.name: testGroupEnd
functions.description: Ends the current test group.

functions.name: testCaseTitle
functions.description: Sets the identifier and title of the current test case.

functions.name: testCaseDescription
functions.description: Sets the description of the current test case.

functions.name: testCaseComment
functions.description: Adds a comment to the test case report.

functions.name: testStep
functions.description: Reports an informational test step.

functions.name: testStepPass
functions.description: Reports a passed test step.

functions.name: testStepFail
functions.description: Reports a failed test step; the test case verdict becomes *fail*.

functions.name: testStepWarning
functions.description: Reports a test step with a warning.

functions.name: testStepErrorInTestSystem
functions.description: Reports an error in the test system itself.

functions.name: testGetVerdictLastTestCase
functions.description: Verdict of the last executed test case (0 pass, 1 fail).

functions.name: testWaitForTimeout
functions.description: Waits for the given time (ms). Returns 0 when the timeout elapsed.

functions.name: testWaitForMessage
functions.description: Waits for a message. Returns 1 when received, 0 on timeout.

functions.name: testWaitForSignalMatch
functions.description: Waits until the signal equals the value.

functions.name: testWaitForSignalInRange
functions.description: Waits until the signal is within [low, high].

functions.name: testWaitForSignalOutsideRange
functions.description: Waits until the signal leaves [low, high].

functions.name: testWaitForTextEvent
functions.description: Waits for a text event raised by `testSupplyTextEvent`.

functions.name: testSupplyTextEvent
functions.description: Raises a text event for `testWaitForTextEvent`.

functions.name: testGetWaitEventMsgData
functions.description: Copies the message that resolved the last wait into a message variable.

functions.name: testReportAddMiscInfo
functions.description: Adds a name/value pair to the report.

functions.name: testReportAddWindowCapture
functions.description: Adds a screenshot of a CANoe window to the report.

functions.name: TestWaitForDiagResponse
functions.description: Waits for the response to a sent diagnostic request. Returns 1 when received.

functions.name: TestWaitForDiagRequestSent
functions.description: Waits until the diagnostic request has been sent.

functions.name: diagSendRequest
functions.description: Sends a diagnostic request to the current target.

functions.name: diagSendResponse
functions.description: Sends a diagnostic response (ECU simulation).

functions.name: diagSendNegativeResponse
functions.description: Sends a negative response with the given NRC.

functions.name: diagSetTarget
functions.description: Selects the target ECU for subsequent diagnostic requests.

functions.name: diagSetParameter
functions.description: Sets a parameter of a request/response by qualifier.

functions.name: diagGetParameter
functions.description: Reads a parameter value of a request/response by qualifier.

functions.name: diagGetLastResponse
functions.description: Copies the last response to the request into a response object.

functions.name: diagGetLastResponseCode
functions.description: -1 for positive response, otherwise the NRC of the last response.

functions.name: diagGetPrimitiveData
functions.description: Copies the raw bytes of a request/response into a buffer.

functions.name: diagSetPrimitiveData
functions.description: Sets the raw bytes of a request/response.

functions.name: diagIsPositiveResponse
functions.description: 1 if the response is positive.

functions.name: diagStartTesterPresent
functions.description: Starts cyclic TesterPresent for the target ECU.

functions.name: diagStopTesterPresent
functions.description: Stops cyclic TesterPresent.
